summary: Model card for Gemini 3 Pro, a sparse MoE natively multimodal reasoning model with optional Deep Think mode. Covers architecture, data, distribution, a capability benchmark table versus competitors, automated content-safety deltas versus Gemini 2.5 Pro, human red-teaming summary, and a Frontier Safety Framework summary table finding no CCLs reached.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: No CCL reached (CBRN, Cyber, Harmful Manipulation, ML R&D, Misalignment); cyber alert threshold met
framework.quote: We evaluated Gemini 3 Pro as outlined in our latest Frontier Safety Framework (September-2025), and found that it did not reach any critical capability levels as outlined in the table below:

capability_benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench 1.5
capability_benchmarks.setting: Overall edit distance, lower is better

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Model provides accurate, occasionally actionable information but not novel/complete enough to significantly uplift low-medium resourced actors; CBRN Uplift Level 1 CCL not reached.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: Gemini 3 Pro provides accurate and occasionally actionable information but generally fails to offer novel or sufficiently complete and detailed instructions

evals: FSF cyber key skills benchmark v1 hard / v2

metrics.name: Key skills v1 hard challenges solved
Key skills v2 challenges solved end-to-end

cyber.finding: Alert threshold met for cyber but Uplift Level 1 CCL not reached.
cyber.quote: v1 hard challenges: 11/12 challenges solved; v2 challenges: 0/13 solved end-to-end. Alert threshold met.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: Better than Gemini 2.5 on RE-Bench tasks but aggregate substantially below alert threshold; ML R&D CCLs not reached.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: However the aggregate score is still substantially below the alert threshold for the CCLs.

metrics.name: Text to Text Safety vs 2.5 Pro
Image to Text Safety vs 2.5 Pro

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety evals reported as relative deltas vs Gemini 2.5 Pro; manual review said losses were false positives or non-egregious.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 3 Pro outperforms Gemini 2.5 Pro across both safety and tone, while keeping unjustified refusals low.

over_refusal.finding: Single relative delta on borderline-prompt refusals.
over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring model's ability to respond to borderline prompts while remaining safe

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Jailbreak vulnerability named as main risk; improved vs 2.5 Pro but no numbers.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: a) jailbreak vulnerability (improved compared to Gemini 2.5 Pro but still an open research problem)

evals: FSF misalignment (exploratory) situational awareness and stealth challenges
deception_scheming.finding: Instrumental Reasoning Levels 1+2 CCL not reached.
deception_scheming.quote: Agent solves 3/11 situational awareness challenges and 1/4 stealth challenges.

honesty_hallucination.finding: Hallucination listed as known limitation; factuality only measured via capability benchmarks.
honesty_hallucination.quote: Gemini 3 Pro may exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation models, such as hallucinations.

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.finding: Satisfied required launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 3 Pro satisfied required launch thresholds

election_misinfo.finding: Manipulative efficacy improves on non-AI baseline but no significant uplift vs prior models; alert thresholds not reached.
election_misinfo.quote: Model manipulative efficacy improves on non-generative AI baseline, but shows no significant uplift versus prior models and does not reach alert thresholds.

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

system_safeguards.finding: Lists lifecycle mitigations including dataset filtering, conditional pre-training, SFT, RL from human and critic feedback, product-level safety filtering.
system_safeguards.quote: product-level mitigations such as safety filtering.

notable_new_eval_methods: Red-teaming scope expanded beyond strict policies (p.9)
Harmful Manipulation and Misalignment (exploratory) FSF domains reported (p.10)

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety eval results computed with improved evaluations and not directly comparable with previous model cards.
Variation expected in automated safety eval results; flagged content manually reviewed.

notes: Safety results given only as relative % deltas vs Gemini 2.5 Pro; note sign conventions (Text to Text Safety -10.4% is described as an improvement in overall framing). Points to separate FSF report.
